chunks: And Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Abū al-Safātij, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
Regarding the saying of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic:
And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell.

key_terms.إِنْ جَازَاهُ: if He requites him; indicating the matter is subject to Allah’s judgment
key_terms.جَهَنَّمُ: Hell, the threatened punishment in the Hereafter
key_terms.فَجَزَاؤُهُ: his recompense; the consequence assigned for the act
key_terms.مُؤْمِنًا: a believer; the sanctity of the victim is central to the verse
key_terms.مُتَعَمِّدًا: deliberately and intentionally, not by mistake

ai.seo_question: Does the verse about intentionally killing a believer mean the punishment is absolutely inevitable?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a concise tafsir of the verse about intentionally killing a believer. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام explains that the threatened punishment of Hell applies if Allah, the Exalted, chooses to requite the killer, highlighting divine judgment and the gravity of unlawful bloodshed.
